timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: CAF has phases. Security is one of them, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: No. Security is an overlay on every phase. Skip it in one and the whole posture leaks.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What does that look like phase by phase?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Strategy sets security objectives. Plan finds skills gaps. Ready builds secure landing zones.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Embed controls during migration. Govern enforces policy. Manage monitors and responds.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: The CIA triad. Confidentiality, integrity, availability. Every control maps to one.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Give me an example of integrity.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Hashing, signing, immutable storage, secure update supply chains. Keep data correct.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery. Keep services reachable.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Always. Verify explicitly, least privilege, assume breach.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Provider, platform teams, SecOps, GRC, awareness. Architect integrates them all.
